description: This file defines a custom dataset class for loading images and labels for object detection training, including methods for data preprocessing, label transformation, and data collation, specifically tailored for YOLO-based models.

classes.name: LoadImagesAndLabels
classes.description: A dataset class for loading images and labels, converting labels, and preparing data for YOLO training.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the dataset, loading image paths and labels from the specified directory.

methods.name: __len__
methods.description: Returns the number of samples in the dataset.

methods.name: __img_path2label_path
methods.description: Converts an image file path to the corresponding label file path.

methods.name: __getitem__
methods.description: Retrieves an image and its label tensors by index.

methods.name: __xywhn2xyxy
methods.description: Converts normalized center_x, center_y, width, height labels to corner coordinates.

methods.name: __load_data
methods.description: Loads and preprocesses an image and its label.

methods.name: __load_raw_label
methods.description: Loads raw label data from a file, ensuring values are within valid ranges.

methods.name: __process_label
methods.description: Processes labels to match image dimensions and converts to YOLO format.

methods.name: collate_fn
methods.description: Collates a batch of data for training, stacking images and concatenating labels.
